annotations.title: Solana Compute-Unit Priority Fee & Jito MEV Tip Estimator

description: Calculates optimal Solana compute-unit (CU) microlamport priority fees and Jito bundle tip lamports to achieve target block-inclusion probability. Use when setting SetComputeUnitPrice and Jito tips before broadcasting a Solana transaction; for querying Bitcoin L1 sat/vB mempool fee rates, use estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'priority_level' ('tx_type' defaults to 'simple_transfer'), supports '?demo=true' or x402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

priority_level.description: Target inclusion urgency tier on Solana mainnet-beta.

tx_type.description: Transaction category used to estimate compute unit limit; defaults to 'dex_swap' when omitted.

name: estimate_solana_priority_fees

recommended_jito_tip_lamports.description: Recommended Jito block-engine tip in lamports for MEV-protected landing.

recommended_micro_lamports_per_cu.description: Recommended priority fee in microlamports per compute unit.
